final: WITH units AS (SELECT s.sentreg, t.ordertypedist AS mix, s.instownpct AS ownership FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS s JOIN transactionrecord AS t ON s.transref = t.transreg WHERE t.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL AND s.instownpct IS NOT NULL), mix_baselines AS (SELECT mix, AVG(ownership) AS baseline FROM units GROUP BY mix), overall AS (SELECT AVG(ownership) AS avg_ownership FROM units), kept AS (SELECT u.ownership, b.baseline, o.avg_ownership FROM units AS u JOIN mix_baselines AS b ON u.mix = b.mix CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE u.ownership > o.avg_ownership) SELECT AVG(ownership) AS avg_ownership, AVG(ownership / baseline) AS avg_ownership_to_mix_baseline, AVG(ownership - avg_ownership) AS avg_excess_overall FROM kept
